sources.title: BGE-Small-LegalEmbeddings-USCode - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a fine-tuned version of the BGE Small embedding model, trained on the USCode-QueryPairs dataset, a subset of the USLawQA corpus. The model is optimized for generating embeddings for legal text, achieving 75% accuracy on the test set.
